title: Low Glycemic Shaggy Bowl
description: A hearty, low glycemic bowl dish perfect for a weeknight dinner or a healthy lunch option.
instructions: 2. Wash and peel the potatoes, then chop them into 1-inch cubes.
3. In a large bowl, toss the potatoes with the Umami and Low until well coated.
4. Spread the potatoes on a baking sheet in a single layer.
5. Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
6. While the potatoes are roasting, prepare the Shaggy sauce.
7. In a small bowl, mix together the Shaggy and Quaffing until well combined.
8. Once the potatoes are done, remove them from the oven and toss with the Shaggy sauce.
9. Serve the potatoes hot, garnished with additional Shaggy if desired.
